thumb.title: MS Dhoni retires from the IPL
thumb.sub: 5 titles. No farewell. Now CSK mentor.

concept: The end of an era told as a handover, not a tribute. The hero sets 'Five titles. No farewell.' in muted grey above the news in white, so the quiet exit is the first thing you feel. Slide 2 is a single giant 0, the IPL 2026 games he played, which answers 'why now' in one glance. Slide 3 turns to what fans will ask next: CSK's Rs 28.05 crore auction purse as the one coloured bar against the biggest (LSG) and smallest (GT) purses, so you see where Chennai stand going into Goa. Slide 4 closes on his new job as mentor and asks if CSK can win without him on the field. Cricket blue, a self-drawing pitch in the reel, type only: no player photos, no team logos.
caption:
Five IPL titles. No farewell game.

MS Dhoni has retired from the IPL. He told Chennai Super Kings on retention deadline day and moves straight into a new role as CSK's team mentor from IPL 2027.

Why now: a calf injury kept him out of the whole 2026 season. There will be no farewell match at Chepauk.

What it means: CSK go to the December 16 mini-auction in Goa with Rs 28.05 crore and 6 squad places to fill (2 overseas). Dhoni stays in team management and is reported to keep a big say in selection.

Can CSK win a title without Dhoni on the field? Tell us below.
